Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring an annual college learning assessment.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to administration of the collegiate learningassessment; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.10 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Within existing resources and beginning in the 200910 academicyear, the public baccalaureate institutions of higher education shallannually administer the collegiate learning assessment to a sample ofstudents attending at least half time. The sample of students shallinclude the following elements: (a) A minimum of one hundred freshmen and one hundred seniors shallbe assessed; institutions may include additional students in the sampleat the institution's discretion. (b) The freshmen shall be assessed in the fall quarter or semesterof their first year; the seniors shall be assessed in the springquarter or semester before their graduation during the same academicyear. (c) The sample shall include students from various majors, studentswho receive student financial aid, and those who did not receive aid. p. 1 HB 1672 (2) Services and activities fees, as defined in RCW 28B.15.041,shall be waived or rebated for all students who participate in thetesting for the entire academic year in which they were tested.
